title: Best Gyms in Auckland 2026 — City-by-City Guide with Prices
meta_desc: Find the best Auckland gyms by suburb, price and contract. Compare gym prices and memberships
intro: Auckland offers a wide range of gym options, with prices varying from $10 to $50 per week. With so many choices, it can be difficult to decide which gym is best for you. In this guide, we'll compare prices and contract terms for popular gyms in Auckland.

sections.heading: Auckland CBD Gyms
sections.body: The Auckland CBD has a high concentration of gyms, with options like Les Mills, Jetts and Anytime Fitness. Prices range from $20 to $40 per week, with most gyms offering 12-month contracts.

sections.heading: Commuter Gyms in Auckland
list: Jetts Auckland CBD: $24.95 per week, 12-month contract
Anytime Fitness Auckland CBD: $29.95 per week, 12-month contract
Les Mills Auckland CBD: $34.95 per week, 12-month contract

sections.heading: Auckland Gym Options with Parking
sections.body: Some gyms in Auckland offer parking, which can be convenient for those who drive to the gym. Jetts and Anytime Fitness have gyms with parking options in the CBD and some suburbs.
